metrics.name: Appointment Completion Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of booked appointments that were completed.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{end_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{start_event}' THEN {user_col} END), 0), 1) AS appointment_completion_rate_pct FROM {table}

metrics.name: Follow-up Visit Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of users with a repeat visit after first consultation.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{matched_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}), 0), 1) AS followup_rate_pct FROM {table}
